problem.name: Star-free regular-language membership
problem.statement_latex: Fix a star-free regular language $L\subseteq\Sigma^*$. Given $x\in\Sigma^n$ by character queries, decide $x\in L$. Star-free means definable from finite languages using union, concatenation and complement.
problem.statement_text: Fix a star-free regular language $L\subseteq\Sigma^*$. Given $x\in\Sigma^n$ by character queries, decide $x\in L$. Star-free means definable from finite languages using union, concatenation and complement.

quantum.headline_latex: $\widetilde O(\sqrt n)$ queries for every fixed star-free language by Aaronson--Grier--Schaeffer. The full regular-language classification has constant, near-square-root, and linear query regimes.
quantum.headline_text: $\widetilde O(\sqrt n)$ queries for every fixed star-free language by Aaronson–Grier–Schaeffer. The full regular-language classification has constant, near-square-root, and linear query regimes.

classical.headline_latex: $O(n)$ time and queries by a fixed finite automaton; languages in the nontrivial star-free query class have $\Theta(n)$ randomized query complexity.
